Definition: a Gizonite or inhabitant of Gizoh
BiblicalUsage: Gizôwnîy means a Gizonite or inhabitant of Gizoh. In 1 Chronicles 11:34, the text says "The sons of Hashem the Gizonite."
TheologicalSignificance: I read gizôwnîy plainly — it means a Gizonite or inhabitant of Gizoh, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
